# SEO-053: Consolidate duplicate route aliases onto one canonical URL

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

## Statement

Where several routes serve the same primary content - a legacy path, a short link, a category-scoped variant - all of them declare the same canonical target rather than each declaring itself.

## Rationale

Aliases that self-canonicalize present the same content as several independent pages, so external links and internal signals are divided among copies instead of accumulating on the address the site wants ranked.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site",
    "has_router"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Identify alias groups by comparing the primary content each route renders, not by comparing paths. For each group choose one address, have the aliases canonicalize to it, and prefer a permanent redirect over a canonical wherever the alias exists only for history.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Fetch every route in an identified alias group and confirm they all declare the same canonical href.
- Evidence: `RENDERED_HTML`, `ROUTE`
- Automated check: none.
